rationale: Direct physical damage to the policyholder's own kitchen caused by a grease fire; fire extinguished by the policyholder; no third-party involvement or liability concerns.
claim_summary: Kitchen fire on POL-1001 (Alex Doe) caused by grease flare-up at stove; charred cabinets and smoke damage contained to kitchen; no injuries; homeowners policy active with $500 deductible and $250,000 limit; confidence 0.95; classified as medium-severity property damage.

case_facts.description: fire caused by grease flare-up at stove; extinguished with fire extinguisher; damage to cabinets above stove (charred) and smoke damage on ceiling and walls
case_facts.extent_of_damage: limited to kitchen; rest of house undamaged

rationale: The claimant reported direct physical damage to their own property (hardwood floor, drywall, and stored items) caused by water in the basement, consistent with a property damage loss covered under their homeowners policy.
claim_summary: Basement flooding with approximately 2 inches of water causing buckled hardwood flooring, soaked drywall (up to 1 foot high), and destroyed stored contents. Policyholder Sam Patel (POL-1004) returned from work trip to find damage. High severity loss with estimated damage exceeding policy deductible of $500. Requires immediate water mitigation and structural assessment. Cause of flooding to be determined during adjuster investigation.

case_facts.damage_description: buckled hardwood floor, soaked drywall up to one foot high, ruined stored boxes

rationale: Direct physical damage to the policyholder's own roof caused by wind; no third-party liability or theft involved.
claim_summary: Wind-damaged roof shingles on back porch overhang; four shingles blown off, estimated repair cost $400, no water intrusion. Low-severity property damage claim. Deductible is $2,500; repair cost is below deductible, so policyholder will bear full repair cost, but claim is documented for records and potential future reference.
